targets.name: jp-agent-render
targets.notes: The jp-agent runtime behind jaytipargal.tech, verified live 2026-10-19. Vercel reaches it through JP_AGENT_URL (Backend/agent-run.js). Deployed from git; render.yaml declares the service shape, and no deploy script, ssh path, systemd unit or nginx config exists in this repository. DNS: runner.jaytipargal.tech and jp-agent.onrender.com both resolve to gcp-us-west1-1.origin.onrender.com via Cloudflare, TLS CN=runner.jaytipargal.tech valid to 2027-01-17. GET /health -> 200 {ok:true,service:"jp-agent",mcp:"in-process"}; /sessions -> 401 without a bearer token. "mcp":"in-process" means the standalone s24-mcp server is not in use and the tools are served in-process from s24-tools.mjs.
